notes.title: The Party Update Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668564/cc9212508fb0a9de95b3065204564eddb8f376e7.png[/img]

Welcome to party town!  Couplinked now supports up to four players!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[u][b]MULTIPLAYER[/b][/u]
-Added four player multiplayer.
-Added ability to play on "teams" where each player can control a single node.
-Added ability to play campaign with two players (each player controls one node).

[u][b]GRAPHICS[/b][/u]
-Lightning has been replaced with LASERS!
-Added dynamic lighting to objects and grid.
-Added explosion when a ring goes off the side of the screen.
-When losing a game, a vignette now highlights the reason for a loss.
-Added background particles for "space" effect.

[u][b]SETTINGS[/b][/u]
-Added configurable settings for survival mode.  This includes setting the speed of the game, number of rows, number of lives, and turning lasers on/off.
-Added option to display FPS.

[u][b]MISC[/b][/u]
-Added alternate controls for 60% keyboards.
-Various bug fixes and performance improvements.

notes.title: Local Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
V2.0 is live!

Enjoy some OUTRAGEOUS local co-op action with a friend!

With this update comes a new price point of $3 USD.  Congrats again to the early adopters that saved such a hefty chunk of change ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668564/3ea77e7821d0c177216b6faf12c760af77a777ef.png[/img]

Notes:
-Added local co-op for two players
-Removed continue feature for survival mode
-Fixed camera shake not 100% returning camera to original position
-Fixed display issues on ultrawide resolutions

notes.title: HUGE Graphics Update!
notes.content:
V1.9 is live!

Enjoy some JUICY new graphics!  Particles, trails, explosions, physics grids, you name it!

With this update comes a new price point of $2 USD.  Congrats to the early adopters ;)

Happy holidays!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668564/f318c6cc87ee8d9ef23649c3639e53d63372dcb6.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.3 is out!
notes.content:
V1.3 is live for beta testers!

Notes:
Fixed a bug where if you hit two objects at the same time and the first one registered causes the game to end, certain objects wouldn't be removed from the screen.
Improved dropdowns in the Display menu.  Changed size and scroll sensitivity.
Fixed issue with mouse/keyboard/gamepad highlighting more than one menu option at a time.
Added more achievements and enabled achievement unlocks!
Added version number to start screen.
